column3: Long lines at lunch rush around noon, waited almost 20 minutes just to get into the hot food station. Food is fine but the wait kills it.
Best dining hall on campus by far. The salad bar is huge and the stir fry station actually has good options for vegetarians.
Solid variety but quality is hit or miss. Some nights the pasta is great, other nights it's mushy. Dessert section is always good though.
Got food poisoning from the chicken once and now I avoid the meat stations. Stick to the salad bar and pizza to be safe.
As a freshman this place is a lifesaver. Open late, swipe with meal plan, and the make-your-own waffle station on weekends is elite.
Gets way too crowded between 12 and 1pm. If you go at 11:30 or after 1:30 it's totally fine and the food is fresher.
Vegan options are surprisingly good here compared to other halls. The tofu scramble at breakfast is a staple for me.
Overpriced if you pay out of pocket without a meal plan. Like $16 for a buffet that's mostly carbs. Only worth it with the plan.
Staff are really friendly and the place is clean. Coffee machine is clutch during finals week when I basically lived here.
Decent for the price with a meal plan. Wish they rotated the menu more, you get tired of the same options after a month.
The international food nights are amazing, they did a Korean night with bibimbap that was better than some restaurants on Durant.
Closes too early on weekends. If you have an evening class or sleep in on Saturday you basically miss out.
